title: Stage Finding
description: A vulnerability finding produced by the auditor/hunter stage. Must pass validation before proof work.

vuln_class.description: Agent-chosen vulnerability class/type. Use the most precise useful label for this target, for example: sqli, graphql-bola, oauth-callback-open-redirect, template-injection.

file.description: Source file path relative to repo root. REQUIRED for source/white-box targets; omit for live black-box targets (use endpoint instead).

line.description: Line number of the sink. REQUIRED with file for source targets; omit for live targets.

endpoint.description: Live target locator: method + path + parameter (e.g. 'GET /api/users?id='). REQUIRED for live black-box targets where file/line are unavailable.

entry_point.description: How attacker input reaches this code path

confidence.description: How sure the auditor is this is exploitable

evidence.description: Structural call path and reasoning, entry → sink. Include relevant code snippets.

attacker_model.description: Who the attacker is (unauth internet, low-priv user, etc.)

subsystem.description: Which subsystem of the target this affects
